caption: The drawing features a small structure resembling a stable or barn situated on a rectangular base. The building has a slanted, dark gray roof with a curved arch over the entrance. The walls of the structure are detailed with crisscrossed and vertical wood-like patterns in shades of tan, brown, and gray. In front of the opening, there is a standing animal, likely a donkey, depicted in shades of gray with a slightly darker mane and tail. The donkey is facing the building with its head angled downward towards a rectangular trough or feeding container positioned near the entrance. The entire composition is set against an empty, off-white background with no additional objects or details surrounding the main scene.
title: Toy Bank: Donkey and House
